title: Ezra theme
description: A calm preventive-health theme: butter-cream page, midnight ink, one terracotta for actions and italic accent words, white square cards on sandy hairlines. A light high-contrast display serif (Newsreader at display optical size) over Inter body; pill buttons, 12px cards, flat. The dark sibling is the original's midnight bands: cream ink, the same terracotta.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's midnight testimonial and footer bands read the .dark colours by putting `dark` on the band
highlight = terracotta for italic accent words; muted = the very light neutral panel; input = the pale pill-outline grey
name: ezra-theme
